[[Darda Goldenchief]] is one of the [[boss]]es that spawns near the end of the [[Ice Caves of Sorrow]] [[mission]]. Be wary of the siege attacks that target areas near this boss.

* [[Dolyak Hide]]
* [[Stone Summit Badge]]

== Notes ==
* He can always be found right after the siege, which usually kills all of the remaining [[Mursaat Elementalist]]s.
